title: MACA loop-unroll refusal combines an implementable fixed grouping with an unqualified pipeline combination
observation: The three retained candidates are valid Cake IR but request partial unroll together with two or four stages; they remain unsupported by this successor. Fresh valid single-stage squared-distance Programs at R128/K256/N32 and R1024/K1024/N64 expose the separate fixed-partial-group gap: factors2/4 that divide the trip count are refused at c72acbd5 despite needing only the existing MACA tl.range and tl.static_range operations. This is a curated exact-source distinction, not a Finding inferred from rejection counts. The captured Triton3.6 range signature accepts loop_unroll_factor, but API keyword availability alone does not qualify the pipelined route.
proposed_change: Implement explicit single-stage fixed partial grouping with an outer range stepping tile*factor and an inner static range, preserving each original iterator value, tail mask, state initialization and once-per-owning-loop finalization. Require the factor to divide the fixed trip count exactly. Preserve full unroll and non-MCFATBIN routes. Keep dynamic/nondividing/pipelined combinations refused, naming the actual factor, stage and trip commitments and requiring an explicit author choice.

verified_by.scope: Compiler-generated factor2 single-stage kernels pass all five original Workload distributions and separate profile at R128/K256/N32 and R256/K256/N64. Fresh paired MCPTI uses250samples/arm and10reversed pairs, with10/10candidate wins:15.360/13.824us (1.1111x),31.488/29.696us (1.0603x). A/A controls pass quality. Full factor4 controls are correct and stable but slower:17.920us and34.304us. Local-serialized physicalGPU0, external activity not excluded. No native3.1, unseen-shape, E/P, serving, all-factor or generalization claim.

promotion_disposition: Promote explicit fixed single-stage partial-unroll emission with the stated guards; no automatic unroll choice. Curate factor2 gains and factor4 regressions as bounded target evidence. Native pipeline variants are numerically executable on captured3.6 but slower; no pipeline promotion or old Study reclassification.

native_engineering.hypothesis: Captured Triton3.6 realizes partial factor2 with stages2 or4 using its native range option, while the cross-version Cake route retains its refusal.
native_engineering.result: Both variants compile, pass all five cases and separate attribution, and pass strict fresh paired quality at R256/K256/N64. Native stages2:31.488/34.048us,0.9248x; native stages4:31.488/34.304us,0.9179x; baseline wins10/10pairs in both. A/A is1.0close_null. These are native results, not Cake results.
native_engineering.promotion_disposition: No promotion of pipelined native variants: no validated performance advantage at this fixed shape, and a compatible Compiler route/minimum-toolchain contract remains separate work. No IR expressibility gap is established.
